description: Manage Git Large File Storage (LFS). Supports tracking/untracking file patterns, listing LFS-tracked files and status, pulling/pushing LFS objects, installing LFS hooks for the repository, and migrating existing files into or out of LFS storage.

everything.description: Pass --all/--everything to include all refs in push/migrate operations.

exclude.description: Comma-separated exclude patterns for migrate or pull operations.

include.description: Comma-separated include patterns for migrate or pull operations.

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the local Git repository. If omitted, falls back to the server default set via the GIT_REPO_PATH environment variable or --repo-path CLI argument.

name: git_lfs
title: Git LFS Actions
